body.p: . To reach working XQuery and XSLT sooner (), packets marked Early in docs/tasks/phase-3.md and phase-4.md may start once the Phase 1 gate has closed (the substrate freeze) and the packets in their "After" lists are committed, while earlier phases still run. All other packets of a phase wait for the previous phase's gate.

item.p: Ownership rules of hold across phases: packets that run at the same time never own the same file; a file named by packets of two phases belongs to whichever runs first, and the other waits.

Seams first: Phase 2 wave 0 makes library parts, evaluator parts for the reserved IR kinds and lowering parts register by glob (packets , ), so XQuery and XSLT packets add files instead of editing the evaluator, the lowering machine or the processor's lists.
Gates stay sequential: the Phase 3 review needs the Phase 2 gate, and a phase's review counts only its own targets. Early packets do not move their phase's gate forward.
CLAUDE.md names the current phase; at each gate the review names the next phase file and the Early packets that may run with it.
